sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Control of Orhanages Act 1958
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
(ACT XXVIII OF
1958)
[24th April 1958]
An Act to
consolidate and amend the law relating to the maintenance of and
control over orphanages in West Pakistan
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.-- (1) This Act may be called the
West Pakistan Control of Orphanages Act, 1958.
(2) If extends to the whole of
the Province of West Pakistan, except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall comes into force one
on such date as the Provincial Government may, by notification in the Official
Gazette, appoint in this behalf.

Definitions

THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958

2. Definitions.-- In 'this'
Act unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context:‑
(i) "District Magistrate" means the District
Magistrate of the district in which the orphanage is situate;
(ii)
"Government" means the Government of West Pakistan;
(iii)
"Manager" means Any person charged with the
management of an orphanage, or any one acting on his behalf;
(iv) "orphan" means any child under the age of fourteen years
who has lost his parents or one of the parents and has no adequate source of
private income;
(v) "orphanage" means a building, structure or enclosure, or
part thereof, which is used for the purpose of accommodating orphans;
(vi) "prescribed" means prescribed by the rules framed under
this Act; and
(vii) "Officer"
means a person appointed by the Government to check orphanages from time to
time.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Control of Orhanages Act 1958
sections.description:
Prohibition to establish or continue an orpbaange without a licence

THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
(ACT XXVIII OF
1958)
[24th April 1958]
An Act to
consolidate and amend the law relating to the maintenance of and
control over orphanages in West Pakistan
3. Prohibition to establish or
continue an orphanage without a licence.-- (1) No
person shall, except in conformity with the conditions of a licence
issued under this Act, establish or continue orphanage:
Provided that a
person continuing an orphanage on the date of commencement of this Act, may obtain a licence within
thirty days of the said date.
(2) A person applying for a licence to run an orphanage shall inform the Direct
Magistrate, whether the orphanage for which he has applied, is a male or female
orphanage.
(3) A person running a male orphanage
shall in no way be entitled to admit female orphan.
(4) Any male person shall not be issued licence
for running a female orphanage.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Control of Orhanages Act 1958
sections.description:
Issue of a licence

THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
(ACT XXVIII OF
1958)
[24th April 1958]
An Act to

control over orphanages in West Pakistan
4. Issue of a licence.--
(1) The District Magistrate may, on receipt of an application in the prescribed
form and after making such inquiry as he may deem necessary under sub-section
(2), issue to any person a licence, without payment
of any fee, for establishing or continuing an orphanage on such conditions as
may be prescribed.
(2) Before issuing a licence the District Magistrate shall satisfy himself
that:-
(i) the orphanage is suitable for
the proper accommodation of orphans;
(ii) the applicant Is competent to discharge his
responsibilities; and
(iii) there is no other cause or reason for which application for
the licence may be refused.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Control of Orhanages Act 1958

Renewal, suspension or cancellation of licence

THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
(ACT XXVIII OF
1958)
[24th April 1958]
An Act to

control over orphanages in West Pakistan
5. Renewal, suspension or
cancellation of licence.--
A licence issued under Section 4:-‑
(i) shall be valid for a period of three years from the date
of issue, and may on an application by the Manager in the prescribed form, be
renewed by the District Magistrate, without payment of any fee, for further
periods not exceeding three years at time; ‑
(ii) may be suspended or cancelled by the District Magistrate, if
there is any contravention of any of the provisions of this Act or any breach
of the conditions of the licence.

6. Appeal.--
If the District Magistrate rejects an application for the issue or the renewal
of a licence or suspends or cancels a licence issued under this Act, he shall record his reason
for doing so in the order and the applicant, licensees or the Manages, as the
case may be, within three months from the date of any such order, prefer an
appeal to the Government. The order passed by the Government on appeal shall be
final and be given effect to by the District Magistrate.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Control of Orhanages Act 1958
sections.description:
Admission and discharge of orphans

THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958
(ACT XXVIII OF
1958)
[24th April 1958]
An Act to
consolidate and amend the law relating to the maintenance of and
control over orphanages in West Pakistan
8. Admission and discharge of
orphans.-- (1) Within seven days of the admission into or discharge from
the orphanage of an orphan, the Manager shall report to the District Magistrate
in the prescribed form the name and other particulars of such orphan.
(2) After verifying, in the
manner prescribed, the orphan received under sub section (1), the District
Magistrate may issue to the Manager such directions regarding admission or
discharge of an orphan as he may deem necessary and the Manager shall carry out
those directions.

9. Medical Examination.-- The Manager
shall have every orphan admitted into the orphanage medically examined within a
week of his admission, and thereafter shall have every such orphan medically
examined once a year. He shall maintain such medical reports and a register
thereof in the prescribed form.

10. Accounts.-- The Manager shall maintain or cause
to be maintained, regular accounts of income and expenditure of the orphanage
in such from as may be prescribed and shall place them before the District
Magistrate twice in a year, that is after every six months.

11. Inspection of reports and
accounts.--
The Manager shall, whenever required by the District Magistrate or any other
Magistrate authorised by the District Magistrate in
this behalf produce the reports or accounts maintained by him under sections 8,
9 and 10, before the District Magistrate or such other Magistrate who may,
after inspection of such reports or accounts issue such directions as he may
deem necessary and the manager shall carry out such directions.

12. Prevention of begging.-- The Manager
shall not permit any orphan admitted into his orphaned to beg for alms or
solicit for donation or subscription in any way or form.

13. Penalties.-- Whoever
contravenes any provisions of this Act shall be punished with rigorous
imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years but which shall to be
less than six months, or with fine which may extend 'to two thousand rupees.

Power to make rules

THE WEST PAKISTAN CONTROL OF ORPHANAGES ACT, 1958

(ACT XXVIII OF

15. Power to make rules.-- (1) This
Government may make rules for the purpose of carrying into effect the
provisions of this Act.
(2) In particular and without
prejudice to the power conferred by sub section (1), such rules may provide far
after any of the following matters:‑
(a) the form of applications for issue or renewal of licenses;
(b) the form and conditions of licences;
(c) the forms of making reports to the District Magistrate
containing particulars of admission into and discharge from the orphanage;
(d) the manner of verification of reports, made and Section 8;
(e) the form of register of medical examination of orphans;
(f) the form of register of income and expenditure; and
(g) any other matter which the Government considers necessary.
